content.value_statement: FlowGram material components need consistent docs, runnable Story examples, API tables, and bilingual review steps. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured workflow for producing those assets.
actual_capabilities: Locate FlowGram material component source files and related exports before drafting documentation.
Create Story component guidance using React.lazy and the project FreeFormMetaStoryBuilder wrapper.
Draft MDX component docs with demos, API reference tables, source walkthroughs, and dependency sections.
Guide screenshot naming, storage paths, and image embedding for material component pages.
Translate approved Chinese documentation to English while preserving code blocks, commands, paths, and links.
Run checklist-style reviews for Story behavior, examples, links, Mermaid diagrams, and terminology.
limitations: The skill is tailored to FlowGram material components and assumes that repository structure.
It does not generate verified screenshots unless the documentation site is run separately.
It requires user confirmation before translating Chinese documentation into English.
It provides templates and workflow guidance, not automatic validation of every component prop.

use_cases.title: Document a new material component
use_cases.description: Turn a FlowGram component source folder into a complete MDX page with demos, API tables, source notes, and dependency links.

use_cases.title: Standardize Story examples
use_cases.description: Create Story examples that follow project naming, lazy loading, wrapper, and type annotation rules.

use_cases.title: Prepare bilingual component docs
use_cases.description: Translate an approved Chinese component document to English while preserving code, paths, commands, and internal link structure.

prompt_templates.title: Start a component document
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the material-component-doc skill to help me document the FlowGram component named <component>. First inspect the source and ask me what examples I want included.

prompt_templates.title: Create Story examples
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to draft Story examples for <component>. Include BasicStory and one advanced scenario, and follow the React.lazy and FreeFormMetaStoryBuilder requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Review an MDX draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this FlowGram material component MDX draft with the skill checklist. Check demos, API tables, source walkthrough, dependencies, screenshots, and link format.

prompt_templates.title: Translate approved documentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for bilingual release work
prompt_templates.prompt: The Chinese document for <component> is approved. Use the skill translation process to create the English version while preserving code blocks, commands, paths, and external links.

output_examples.input: Document the variable selector material component.
output: A source review summary covering props, exports, hooks, and dependencies.
A Story plan with BasicStory and an advanced schema-filtered example.
An MDX outline with demos, API reference, source guide, flow diagram, and dependency sections.

output_examples.input: Review this component documentation before publishing.
output: A checklist result for Story behavior, code examples, API completeness, links, screenshot paths, and Mermaid syntax.
A short list of required fixes before translation or publication.

output_examples.input: Translate the approved Chinese docs to English.
output: English headings and prose with component names and technical terms preserved.
Unchanged code blocks, commands, file paths, external links, and Markdown formatting.

best_practices: Inspect the component source, exports, hooks, and dependencies before drafting the document.
Confirm the Chinese document with the user before starting the English translation.
Verify Story examples and documentation links in the docs site before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not import material components directly in Story examples when the project requires React.lazy.
Do not translate code blocks, commands, paths, component names, or API identifiers.
Do not publish a component page with missing props, broken links, or unchecked screenshot paths.

faq.question: What repository structure does this skill expect?
faq.answer: It expects FlowGram docs and material packages, including docs source folders, Story components, material source folders, and the material MDX template.

faq.question: Can it create Story components?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives naming, lazy loading, wrapper, and type annotation rules for FlowGram material Story components.

faq.question: Does it translate documentation automatically?
faq.answer: Only after the user confirms the Chinese documentation is approved. The skill explicitly delays translation until that confirmation.

faq.question: Does it validate screenshots?
faq.answer: It gives screenshot timing, naming, storage, and embed rules. The user or agent must still run the docs site to capture and verify images.

faq.question: Can it document non-FlowGram React components?
faq.answer: It can provide general structure, but the paths, wrappers, imports, and templates are specific to FlowGram material components.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
